controller_scope: Independent offline reception only; no workflow/ref/study or product-source change.

previously_accepted_originals.reuse_rule: These nine previously received artifact IDs/bytes/SHA remain pinned. Final consumer re-reads original build and all150 raw; it never combines their old compact receipts as replacement samples.

operation.batch_name: Explicit batch-NNN, fresh directory; same prepare or replay cannot run again in place.
operation.prepare: One complete paginated before snapshot, original ZIPs selected by actual API IDs/digests, whole-ZIP SHA and every member CRC/SHA, bounded complete expansion, after snapshot and unchanged selected IDs/digests. No polling, retry or accepting a subset as full coverage.
operation.incomplete_prepare: Transport may complete with explicit missing core names and measurement_qualification not_run. Such a batch cannot launch original aggregate.
operation.full_replay: Requires301 exact core originals: one build,150capacity,150shards. One original aggregate performs validate_build and all150 validate_shard→inspect_raw→combine. Separate original capacity helper checks all150. Original50 groups×N30=1500, full15-table parity and environment strata remain.
operation.optional_remote: Never require all152 jobs green or302 artifacts. Retain all actual job statuses and any original remote failure/missing result. A published successful matrix must exact_equal the independent original result after only registered evidence[].directory relocation. A failed matrix remains unchanged and is not called successful. No Actions-full-success claim.
operation.published_after_selection: A newly observed remote matrix is recorded, not silently added or ignored; complete-core replay refuses that stale batch until its published matrix is received in a separately fixed bounded reception. No automatic retry.
operation.remote_directory_mapping: Only /home/runner/work/_temp/p8-scale-shards/<exact shard artifact name> maps to the same artifact name under this batch/transport/expanded; exactly150 unique paths and receipt identities. No other field/order/number normalization.

Docker.cleanup: Only validated ID returned by this exact docker create

operation.source_clean_rule: Original product snapshot and committed observer hashes only. Do not delete or reject unrelated untracked __pycache__; preserve any such paths appearing in original raw provenance.

custody.originals: All selected ZIPs, complete JSON API pages, all full member inventories and actual expanded bytes retained; source/observer/inputs before-after remain.
custody.job_logs: Raw job logs are not automatically downloaded by this consumer and may include signed storage URLs. Full job/step API statuses are retained. Provider logs remain a separately obtainable source; they are not an added measurement gate.
custody.errors: Preserve partial files and failure receipts. Public exception descriptions expose only type and basename/function/line. No token, signed URI or credential-bearing argv output.
custody.authentication: Existing standard host gh credentials only in prepare; no token forwarding to offline container.

pending_validation.first_author_probe: One pure-control native request returned tunnel_client_not_connected HTTP404. No dynamic pass claimed and no retry made.

draft_history.delta: Only add the standalone preserved native transport-failure receipt; source, consumer, operator, budgets and execution scope unchanged.
